# hpe_morpheus_network_group (Resource)

Manages a Morpheus Network Group resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hpe_morpheus_network_group" "example" {
  name        = "Production Networks"
  description = "Network group for production workloads"
  visibility  = "private"
  active      = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the network group.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the network group is active.
- `description` (String) The description of the network group.
- `resource_permission_group_ids` (Set of Number) List of group (site) IDs that are allowed access.
- `resource_permission_groups_all` (Boolean) Allow access to all groups (sites).
- `tenant_ids` (Set of Number) List of tenant account IDs that are allowed access. Master-account only.
- `visibility` (String) The visibility of the network group.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of the network group.

## Import

Import is supported using the resource ID.

```bash
terraform import hpe_morpheus_network_group.example 123
```
